task_objective: Fix strict per-track @decky/ui version tracking in Upstream UI Library workflow and align @decky/ui-v5 to 5.0.0 so issue #14 can be cleanly closed without weakening strict drift alerts.
tests_added: tests/runtime/test_upstream_ui_check.py (11 unit tests covering lockfile parsing for dual-client/single-client/peer-suffix/missing cases, strict exact-equality comparison for main/release/alias drift, Markdown table rendering, and CLI JSON/Markdown output)
design_decisions: Extracted upstream UI lockfile parsing, strict comparison, and Markdown rendering from inline workflow bash into scripts/runtime/upstream_ui_check.py (pure Python stdlib, compatible with Python 3.10+ on ubuntu-22.04 and pinned Python 3.14).

Enforced strict exact equality per track in dual-client mode (@decky/ui == upstream main, @decky/ui-v5 == upstream main, @decky/ui-legacy == upstream latest release) with automatic fallback to single-client strict equality when @decky/ui-legacy and @decky/ui-v5 are removed.

Pinned @decky/ui-v5 from 5.0.1 to 5.0.0 in frontend/package.json after verifying decky-frontend-lib v5.0.0..v5.0.2 diffs contain only TypeScript type annotations and zero runtime JS changes, eliminating duplicate 5.x entries in pnpm-lock.yaml and establishing exact parity with upstream v4.0.0-pre1.

results.frontend: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, lint, typecheck, build, and 30/30 node --test passed
results.live_dry_run: in_sync=true (@decky/ui=5.0.0, @decky/ui-v5=5.0.0 vs upstream main 5.0.0; @decky/ui-legacy=4.16.4 vs upstream v3.3.1 4.16.4; decky-frontend-lib v5.0.2)
